title: Harira (Moroccan lentil and chickpea soup) with chicken
steps: Chop the onion, celery, garlic and ginger and dice the chicken.
Fry in the oil for 5 minutes and briefly toast the spices.
Add the tomatoes, stock and rinsed lentils and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for 10 more minutes, then season with salt and lemon juice.
